concept: S3 One Zone-IA: cheap storage for infrequent data in one AZ
tests: Choosing a storage class for data read once a quarter when single-AZ storage is acceptable.
expected: S3 One Zone-IA is cheaper than Standard-IA, data in one AZ, instant access. Triggers: "once per quarter", "single AZ acceptable", "lowest storage cost".
why_not: Standard is more expensive; Standard-IA stores across multiple AZs and costs more; Deep Archive — hours to retrieve, not for ad hoc reports.
